what: node_classes/concept-piece.json carries NO workflow_versions. Decide its workflow — or decide it does not get one, and say what that means.
why_it_needs_adjudication: The class carries everything EXCEPT the machine-readable string: invariant, prove_gate (quorum signature — review, not build), kicks_back_on, one member (press_office/IntentionBasedDesignForHumans.md). Two ratified sources contradict: tickets/ticket-and-task.json's 'concept-piece@v1' string claims THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> LEARNME -> PROVED, while tickets/state-machine-physics.json says THINKME -> REVIEWME -> PROVED. The first is code-seam's path copied onto a class that does not build, so the drift has a direction and CC's read is that state-machine-physics is right — but a class definition is RATIFIED BY AKIEN (node_classes/_charter+why.json signature gate), so CC does not get to pick.
blocks: 1 of 17 fleet nodes cannot validate its workflow string at all ('unknown workflow version v1, known: []'). ticket-and-task.json is that node.
source: node_classes/concept-piece.json; measured 2026-08-02 (3 of 5 classes absent: concept-piece, host-seam, operational-driver)

resolved.ruling: Akien, 2026-08-03: 'workflow versions would be meaningless. a workflow is composed at ticketing time by the ticketer based on the needs of the ticket.'
resolved.became: TICKET — the-workflow-belongs-to-the-instance (consequence), plus the taxonomy node cast the same turn; NOT a workflow for this class.
resolved.note: Also ruled, same turn: 'concept-piece was my term. it eventually became /idea which has not been built yet apparently.' So this class is SUPERSEDED by /idea, not merely workflow-less — which is a second finding this item did not know it was holding.
resolved.cc_read_of_the_consequence: CC's read of the consequence, NOT ruled: this does not merely fill three empty cells — it relocates the workflow from the CLASS to the INSTANCE. cairn/base/transitions.py::_registered_workflow refuses any version a class does not define, and _conform requires the node's path to MATCH the class-registered path exactly (free_summons aside). Under this ruling both are validating against the wrong owner: there is no class-level path for a ticketer-composed workflow to conform to. code-seam and skill still carry workflow_versions v1/v2, so the change is not a no-op for them either. What the class plausibly still owns is the CONSTRAINTS (which summonses are gates that may not be skipped) — that preserves the original why (a string cannot quietly skip PROVEME) while letting the ticketer compose the path. That reconciliation is a design detail for the corpus, not another question for Akien; it is carried into the consequence ticket, not settled here.
